description: IFSC code lookup for Indian bank branches: returns the bank, branch name, address, city, district, state, MICR code, SWIFT code where available, and whether the branch supports NEFT, RTGS, IMPS and UPI. Covers all banks in India including SBI, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank and co-operative banks, from the open Razorpay IFSC dataset built on RBI and NPCI lists. Useful for validating Indian bank transfer details before a payout. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402, Base mainnet).

ifsc.description: 11-character IFSC code, e.g. HDFC0000001 or SBIN0000300
